title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.105.0, contain a Deserialization of… (CVE-2026-111517)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.105.0 have a Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-111517 and has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.4.
